newsitem.title: UK: Boots launches television home shop trials.
newsitem.headline: Boots launches television home shop trials.

text.p: British pharmacist and retailer Boots Co Plc said on Friday that it planned to test home shopping via television from April 16 in Kingston-upon-Hull, northeast England.
In a statement, the company said that customers would have a set-top box with a special remote control unit giving access to the service, which would include a virtual Boots store.
Customers will be able to place orders 24 hours a day, seven days a week with free deliveries from 0800 BST to 2100 BST.
Boots said the service would initially be available in 250 homes with the potential for a national roll-out from 1998 onwards.
Boots said the home shopping market, which was valued at 7.4 billion stg in 1995, was forecast to grow by 5.6 percent a year. -- London Newsroom +44171 542 7717
